Coverage gates enforced at 90% in pytest and vitest; ruff/ty and Biome adopted; documented once in DEVELOPERS.md and referenced everywhere else

compose.yaml now mounts postgres_data at /var/lib/postgresql. Verified: container reports healthy and 'uv run pytest' passes (1 passed, 100% coverage). No doc change needed - the documented command is unchanged.

Design complete and documented: docs/data-model.md (entity model) and docs/decisions/0008-stock-ledger-transfer-graph.md (rationale). All schema decisions settled with Ali. The remaining custody-depth question is a workflow decision tracked separately as inventory-tng-8sq and does not block implementation.

Catalogue models implemented: Category, Volunteer, Location, Item, ItemIdentifier, Vendor, VendorOffer, Label, with django-simple-history on all of them and admin registration. All invariants from docs/data-model.md are database constraints, each covered by a test that asserts IntegrityError. 43 tests pass at 100% coverage; ruff, ruff format and ty all clean. Docs updated in the same change: docs/data-model.md (Label design changed during implementation to two nullable FKs plus a check constraint, rather than a generic relation), docs/architecture.md, and the django-backend skill.

Implemented and verified. ruff ANN enabled in backend/pyproject.toml so the existing 'ruff check' step enforces it in CI with no new tool or command; ANN401 off so Any is a legal annotation and there is always a way through. Generated migrations exempt. Documented at DEVELOPERS.md#typing (bar, three helper commands, ty's blind spots, editor setup, learning links), Definition of Done, AGENTS.md, and the django-backend skill. ADR docs/decisions/0009-type-annotations-required.md. Verified both directions: unannotated code fails, Any passes.

StockTransaction, StockMovement and the derived StockBalance view implemented. All invariants are database constraints (quantity > 0, at least one side, from != to, partial-unique idempotency key). Append-only is enforced by a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger rather than by revoking privileges: verified that the postgres image makes POSTGRES_USER a superuser, and superusers bypass privilege checks, so a REVOKE would have enforced nothing. docs/data-model.md, ADR 0008 and docs/architecture.md corrected to match in the same change. 59 tests pass at 100% coverage; ruff, format and ty clean.

OAS_VERSION pinned to 3.1.1 (verified drf-spectacular emits 3.0.3 by default and supports 3.1/3.2; chose 3.1 for JSON Schema 2020-12 alignment with broad tooling support). Schema committed at backend/openapi.yaml. Currency is enforced by a TEST rather than a separate CI step, so local and CI runs are identical - same shape as ADR 0007's coverage gate; verified the test actually fails on drift and passes once regenerated. A second test requires every operation to document a typed response body, which caught that the health endpoint documented no payload at all. Added /api endpoint index for discovery. ADR docs/decisions/0010-openapi-version.md; documented at DEVELOPERS.md#the-api-schema.

MIT LICENSE added at the repository root. Verified the body matches the SPDX MIT text exactly after whitespace/case normalisation, which is what GitHub's licensee uses to report the license on the repo main page, and confirmed the file is not gitignored. License also declared as an SPDX expression in backend/pyproject.toml and frontend/package.json, and linked from README. Deliberately no license-files entry in pyproject: ../LICENSE sits outside the project directory and build backends reject that; the text lives once, at the root.

Added a 'Migrations match the models' step to the backend CI job running makemigrations --check --dry-run. Verified both directions by adding a field with no migration (exit 1, CI would fail) and reverting (exit 0). Noted in the django-backend skill next to the existing migration guidance.

Design complete: docs/decisions/0011-qr-batch-scanning.md. Cart is the interface, scanning is one of three ways to fill it; WASM decoding primary (native BarcodeDetector verified absent on Chrome Windows/Linux and Firefox, off by default in Safari, partial on Chrome macOS); wall QR and item labels unified as one Label mechanism; Label.quantity closes the packet-vs-piece ambiguity. 15 implementation beads created. Two questions left for the owner: app authorisation (inventory-tng-0pj) and what historical zip-tie 1s meant. Went through review, four-lens simplify, and correction: the ADR was cut 552 -> 310 lines and ten factual claims were corrected, including a browser-support table that was wrong and a deployment claim about rejected certificates that was false.
